user_story: As a staff member, I want to confirm a booking so that the guest knows their reservation is secured.

positive.title: Confirm a pending booking successfully
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Select a pending booking to confirm.
positive.expected_result: The booking is confirmed and the guest receives a confirmation notification.

negative.title: Attempt to confirm a booking with missing staff permissions
steps: Log in as a user without staff permissions.
Attempt to select and confirm a pending booking.
negative.expected_result: The system prevents the action and displays an error message indicating insufficient permissions.

edge.title: Confirm a booking that has already been canceled
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Select a booking that has already been canceled.
Attempt to click the 'Confirm Booking' button.
edge.expected_result: The system does not allow a canceled booking to be confirmed and provides a relevant message.
